review_policy: severe-artifact veto first, then visibly stylized film-inspired appeal
observations: The darker, denser rendering is consistently preferred on foliage, water, street furniture, architecture and fisheye interiors because it retains structure and avoids a pale cyan veil.
The warm wood cabinet is preferred to the pale cabinet rendering; the magenta night balcony is preferred to the cyan lifted alternative despite its stronger colour cast.
No option is rejected for severe geometry, text, object, banding, seam, clipping-block or repeated-texture corruption at contact-sheet scale.
claim_ceiling: Autonomous blind visual evidence on source-disjoint confirmation contact sheets; not population preference, full-resolution adjudication, stock response, calibration or product promotion.
